steps.name: news-editorial-last-event
steps.script:
$f='C:\TTiTTulares\ttittulares-mobile-trigger.log'
$l=[string](Get-Content $f -Tail 250 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'EDITORIAL PROCESS|LAUNCH CONFIRMED|LAUNCH FAILED|CHAT MESSAGE|LAUNCH ERROR' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
Write-Output ('TTRESULT:'+(@{state='ok';last=$l.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(500,$l.Length))}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
